sn17.9:1.3: upari bhikkhave ākāse verambhā nāma vātā vāyanti
sn17.9:1.4: tattha yo pakkhī gacchati tamenaṃ verambhā vātā khipanti
sn17.9:1.5: tassa verambhavātukkhittassa aññeneva pādā gacchanti aññena pakkhā gacchanti aññena sīsaṃ gacchati aññena kāyo gacchati.
sn17.9:1.6: evameva kho bhikkhave idhekacco bhikkhu lābhasakkārasilokena abhibhūto pariyā dinnacitto pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya pavisati arakkhiteneva kāyena arakkhitāya vācāya arakkhitena cittena anupaṭṭhitāya satiyā asaṃvutehi indriyehi
sn17.9:1.7: so tattha passati mātugāmaṃ dunnivatthaṃ vā duppārutaṃ vā
sn17.9:1.8: tassa mātu gāmaṃ disvāna dunnivatthaṃ vā duppārutaṃ vā rāgo cittaṃ anuddhaṃseti
sn17.9:1.9: so rāgānuddhaṃsena cittena sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattati
sn17.9:1.10: tassa aññe cīvaraṃ haranti aññe pattaṃ haranti aññe nisīdanaṃ haranti( aññe sūcigharaṃ haranti verambhavātukkhittasseva sakuṇassa.
